Planning Document 2

Clause 1: Development on land identified on the Biodiversity Map as Bandicoot Protection Area, provided in Appendix 3, may be required to undertake an assessment of significance.

Clause 2: Development on land identified on the Biodiversity Map as Wildlife Corridor, provided in Appendix 3, must incorporate native vegetation as part of any landscaping works.

Clause 3: Buildings must be located to provide an outlook to public open space without appearing to privatise that space.
